author: Kuokka77
description:
"Big Hat, No Cattle" demo OST by Mygg. Demo (by Bitbendaz) ranked 3rd at Gerp 2026.
Art from the demo by Java (presumably).

The still image is using CRT emulation. A lenghty guide by John Novak for setting it up in WinUAE can be found here:
https://bit.ly/4rojuio

A1200 r1D.4 audio. Recorded from a running demo. Dolby Headphone DSP effect applied.
title: Amiga music: Mygg - Big Hat, No Cattle demo OST (A1200🎧Dolbyfied)
